description: This file defines the User entity class for a Java-based backend application, using JPA annotations for ORM mapping to a database table named 'users'. It includes entity fields such as id, username, email, passwordHash, and a list of notes associated with the user. The class also provides constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing application users with fields for username, email, password, and related notes.
